Maya Lopez: Hey team — quick ask for the May webinar follow-up package. Need a micro-template pack (3 email headers, 2 LinkedIn post images, 1 one-pager PDF) + a lead-routing note for Sales. Can we scope this for tomorrow?

Evan Park: Yes. Are the email headers data-first or brand-first?

Maya Lopez: Data-first for nurture emails, brand-first for LinkedIn.

Rina Suzuki: I'll design 3 header masters in Figma with 600x200 exports and mobile-safe crops. Also will include a plain-text fallback.

Tom (Brand): Keep to token palette only. Primary #0E4FFF, Accent #06C2A6, Neutral #111827. Inter only.

Jules (Growth): Routing: all webinar signups should set utm_campaign=may_webinar and tag source=web and lead_tier based on company_size. I'll add a sample webhook payload for Sales.

Maya Lopez: Great — include a tiny benchmark stat on headers: "p95 42ms, 85% throughput gain". Make it discreet.

Rina Suzuki: Noted. Also going to create a one-page PDF one-pager with micro-diagram (before/after flow) sized A4 and an export at 1200px width.

legal-bot: Reminder: do not use customer names in public assets. If referencing the benchmark, add privacy line: "No customer prompts logged for demos". EU assets require GDPR footer.

Tom (Brand): I'll add a brand-compliance checklist page in the Figma file with color swatches, spacing tokens, and alt-text examples.

Jules (Growth): For lead routing, include this mapping in the handoff: slack_channel=#leads-web, owner_team=AE, notify=leadbot@example.com. Also recommend CSV export spec.

Maya Lopez: Timeline: sketches today, masters tomorrow noon, handoff + export by Wednesday AM. Owners: Rina = design, Tom = brand checklist, Jules = routing spec, Maya = final QA.

Rina Suzuki: Uploading sketches to Figma now: https://www.figma.com/file/launch/micro-templates — tagging owners.

Evan Park: Will review assets for mobile readability after Rina uploads. :thumbsup:

Maya Lopez: Perfect. Thanks everyone — ping me once masters are in.
